verdict.rationale: A public pricing page exists at spline.design/pricing, and its excerpt lists tier features such as code and self-hosted exports, file version history and Team Library, so plan tiers are published with some feature differentiation. Nothing in the evidence shows seat types or how AI features (AI Agent, AI textures, 3D generation) are gated by plan. Missing for 10: seat-type definitions and per-seat pricing, explicit tier names and prices, AI-feature gating or credit limits per plan, independent corroboration of pricing clarity.
